extracted.name: Nana’s Apple Crisp
extracted.description: Apples are covered with an oat and cinnamon crumble, topped with butter and baked -- very quick to assemble!
ingredient_lines: 6 tart apples - peeled, cored, and sliced
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Place apples in a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a bowl, mix melted butter, flour, sugar, oats, and 1 tablespoon cinnamon to form a crumbly mixture. Sprinkle over apples.
Dot with remaining 1/4 cup butter, and sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon cinnamon.
Bake 50 minutes in the preheated oven, until lightly browned and apples are tender.
